parole.testo: [Alt: Photograph of two people in Klingon costume] c. 1960s, from the Star Trek franchise, purportedly by Gene Roddenberry, named for Lieutenant Wilbur Clingan of the Los Angeles Police Department. In-universe, the name was a transcription of Klingon tlhIngan.

parole.significato: A phrase said to wish somebody good fortune, particularly fortune in some form of honourable battle.
